sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Care Privacy - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain any info about TerraGroup's research in Health Resort west wing on Shoreline
- Hand over the retrieved information
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Propital regenerative stimulant injector
- Unlocks barter for Propital regenerative stimulant injector at Peacekeeper LL2
"Do you have the documents? Let me have a look... Indeed, the distinctive doctor’s handwriting. Thank you, young man."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Health Resort west wing room 306 key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks Health Resort west wing room 306 on Shoreline where the Secure Folder 0060 is located. |
| Secure Folder 0060 | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The Secure Folder 0060 can be found on Shoreline, in room 306 of the west wing at the Resort, located on a windowsill.
